tasks.subject: Task 1: Widen the CMake gate so SOGEN_ENABLE_FEX recognizes iOS
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `cmake --preset=ios-embed-simulator` (and `ios-embed-device`) reports `SOGEN_ENABLE_FEX: enabled`, without affecting any existing Linux/Darwin-desktop configure.

**Files:**
- Modify: `CMakeLists.txt:67-69`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Configuring with `ios-embed-simulator` or `ios-embed-device` prints an "enabled" FEX-backend status message mentioning iOS.
- [ ] Configuring with `release` (desktop macOS) still reports the existing Darwin message unchanged.
- [ ] Non-arm64/non-Clang hosts still leave `SOGEN_ENABLE_FEX` OFF exactly as before.

**Verify:** `cmake --preset=ios-embed-simulator 2>&1 | grep "FEX backend"` -> prints an "enabled" line mentioning iOS.

**Steps:** Add `OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS"` to the gate's last clause in `CMakeLists.txt:67-69`; verify both the iOS and desktop presets; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["CMakeLists.txt"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --preset=ios-embed-simulator 2>&1 | grep 'FEX backend'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ios-embed-simulator/ios-embed-device configure report SOGEN_ENABLE_FEX enabled", "release preset unaffected", "non-matching hosts still OFF"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Build FEXCore as a static library for iOS, with real cross-compilation forwarding
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `deps/CMakeLists.txt`'s `fex_external` ExternalProject produces a genuine arm64-apple-ios/arm64-apple-ios-simulator static `libFEXCore.a` (not a host-Mac dylib), imported as `fexcore` for iOS builds - leaving the existing Darwin-desktop/Linux shared-library path untouched.

**Files:**
- Modify: `deps/CMakeLists.txt:142-223`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `fex_external` configures with CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=iOS and the correct sysroot/arch for ios-embed-simulator, not the host Mac's.
- [ ] `libFEXCore.a` for the target architecture appears at the expected build-tree path after building (confirmed via `file`/`lipo -info`).
- [ ] Desktop (release) and Linux paths are bit-for-bit unaffected (still FEXCore_shared/.dylib/.so, still SHARED IMPORTED).

**Verify:** `cmake --build build/ios-embed-simulator --target fex_external && file build/ios-embed-simulator/deps/fex_external-prefix/src/fex_external-build/FEXCore/Source/libFEXCore.a` -> Mach-O arm64 simulator object.

**Steps:** Confirm FEXCore's existing static `FEXCore` target (`AddLibrary(${PROJECT_NAME} STATIC)` at `deps/FEX/FEXCore/Source/CMakeLists.txt:305`); branch `deps/CMakeLists.txt`'s Darwin-family/library-kind logic to add an iOS case building the static target with `CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE`/`CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT`/`CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES`/`CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR` forwarded, importing `fexcore` as STATIC IMPORTED for iOS; build+inspect; confirm desktop unaffected; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["deps/CMakeLists.txt"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build build/ios-embed-simulator --target fex_external && file build/ios-embed-simulator/deps/fex_external-prefix/src/fex_external-build/FEXCore/Source/libFEXCore.a", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fex_external cross-compiles for iOS instead of the host Mac", "libFEXCore.a is a real iOS/simulator static archive", "desktop and Linux paths unaffected"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Link FEXCore into the iOS app and add a FEX backend selection toggle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** SogenIOS.app links `libFEXCore.a` and fex-emulator's static archive, and can construct a FEX-backed emulator instead of Unicorn via a compile-time/env toggle (no UI picker).

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/sogen-ios/project.yml`
- Modify: `tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/SogenBridge.mm:168`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] SogenIOS's OTHER_LDFLAGS -force_loads libFEXCore.a for both iphoneos*/iphonesimulator* SDKs, mirroring the existing MoltenVK lines.
- [ ] fex-emulator's static archive is on the app's link line.
- [ ] Setting the toggle constructs `sogen::backend_type::fex`; unset preserves today's Unicorn-only behavior exactly.
- [ ] App still builds/launches in the Simulator with the toggle unset.

**Verify:** Build+run in the Simulator with toggle unset -> unchanged Phase 1 behavior; build+run with toggle set -> app launches (correctness is Task 5's job).

**Steps:** Add -force_load entries for libFEXCore.a/fex-emulator's archive in project.yml alongside the existing MoltenVK lines; change `SogenBridge.mm:168` to select `sogen::backend_type::fex` behind a `SOGEN_IOS_USE_FEX` compile definition; smoke-test both configurations; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/sogen-ios/project.yml", "tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/SogenBridge.mm"], "verifyCommand": "build+run SogenIOS in the Simulator with the toggle unset and then set", "acceptanceCriteria": ["FEXCore force_load wired for both SDKs", "toggle switches backend_type between fex and unicorn", "toggle-unset behavior matches Phase 1 exactly"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Simulator proof - FEX renders all 8 frames correctly
tasks.description:
**USER-ORDERED GATE - NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation ("all work should be done starting in Simulator and then once its assumed to have worked I will demo on a real iphone for you"). It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Goal:** With the Task 4 toggle set to FEX, native-gpu-clear-sample.exe runs to completion in the iOS Simulator via the FEX backend, rendering all 8 clear-color frames correctly and ending on violet - matching Phase 1's Task 7 success criteria, via FEX instead of Unicorn.

**Files:** None expected beyond whatever real bugs surface.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The Simulator's on-screen view cycles blue -> green -> red -> yellow -> cyan -> magenta -> orange -> violet and holds on violet.
- [ ] The captured log shows `[ngcs] done`.
- [ ] The captured log shows the final frame's first_pixel decoding to violet (or equivalent direct evidence).
- [ ] A log line or other direct evidence confirms the FEX backend actually executed (not a silent fallback to Unicorn).

**Verify:** Run in the Simulator with the FEX toggle set, capture sogen_log.txt from the app's Documents folder (or `xcrun simctl launch --console-pty`), confirm all criteria.

**Steps:** Add a startup log line confirming the active backend; run in the Simulator and fix whatever real bugs surface with real evidence, not guessing; re-verify every acceptance criterion explicitly; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Port the JIT26 client primitives into the deps/FEX fork
tasks.description:
**Goal:** deps/FEX gains its own self-contained copy of the JIT26 breakpoint-protocol client primitives, independent of the app target's JIT26.c, so libFEXCore.a never needs to resolve those symbols across a library boundary.

**Files:**
- Create: `deps/FEX/FEXCore/Source/Utils/JIT26.c` (match tools/sogen-ios/Sources/JIT/JIT26.c's language)
- Create: `deps/FEX/FEXCore/include/FEXCore/Utils/JIT26.h`
- Reference only: `tools/sogen-ios/Sources/JIT/JIT26.c`, `tools/sogen-ios/Sources/JIT/JIT26.h`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] New files compile as part of FEXCore's iOS-device build, gated to compile to inert/unused code on Simulator and desktop (mirroring src/common/utils/ios_device_jit_mmap_shim.cpp's own `#if defined(__APPLE__) && TARGET_OS_IPHONE && !TARGET_OS_SIMULATOR` gate).
- [ ] jit26_prepare_region/jit26_writable_alias/jit26_detach/jit26_is_debugged declared with identical signatures to the app target's JIT26.h.
- [ ] ios-embed-simulator and desktop release both unaffected.

**Verify:** `cmake --build build/ios-embed-device --target fex_external` succeeds with new files compiled in; `cmake --build --preset=release --target windows-emulator-test && ctest --test-dir build/release` still passes.

**Steps:** Copy the real JIT26.c/.h content verbatim into the new deps/FEX files (not a reimplementation from description); gate the whole file to real device only; add to FEXCore's Source/CMakeLists.txt source list; build and confirm inertness elsewhere; commit inside deps/FEX then bump the pin in the main repo.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["deps/FEX/FEXCore/Source/Utils/JIT26.c", "deps/FEX/FEXCore/include/FEXCore/Utils/JIT26.h", "deps/FEX/FEXCore/Source/CMakeLists.txt"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build build/ios-embed-device --target fex_external && cmake --build --preset=release --target windows-emulator-test && ctest --test-dir build/release", "acceptanceCriteria": ["real JIT26 primitives ported verbatim", "gated inert on simulator/desktop", "desktop tests still pass"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Wire FEXCore's JIT allocator through JIT26 on real device
tasks.description:
**Goal:** On real iOS device, FEXCore's JIT code-buffer allocation goes through jit26_prepare_region/jit26_writable_alias (the exact RX/RW splitwx pattern already proven for Unicorn's TCG buffer) instead of plain mmap(..., MAP_JIT), confirmed insufficient there even under a real externally-granted CS_DEBUGGED.

**Files:**
- Modify: `deps/FEX/FEXCore/include/FEXCore/Utils/AllocatorHooks.h` (the two VirtualAlloc() overloads, ~lines 137-153 pre-Task-6)
- Modify: `deps/FEX/FEXCore/Source/Interface/Core/JIT/JIT.cpp` (guard-page/TempCodeBuffer logic, `#ifdef __APPLE__` sections)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Both VirtualAlloc() overloads route through jit26_prepare_region/jit26_writable_alias when Execute is true and the target is real iOS device, returning the writable-alias pointer as the result.
- [ ] Every address used as a jump target or embedded/executed goes through the corresponding RX conversion, not the RW alias (a splitwx-style diff/conversion mechanism, same idea as deps/unicorn's own fix).
- [ ] Existing macOS/MAP_JIT desktop behavior is completely unchanged.
- [ ] Desktop windows-emulator-test (which exercises this exact AllocatorHooks.h on macOS/Apple Silicon) still passes in full.

**Verify:** `cmake --build --preset=release --target windows-emulator-test && ctest --test-dir build/release` still passes in full; real-device correctness is confirmed only via Task 8's handoff.

**Steps:** Read both files in full; add an RX/RW conversion mechanism mirroring deps/unicorn's sogen_tcg_splitwx_diff pattern; route both VirtualAlloc() overloads through JIT26 on real device only; fix up JIT.cpp's consumers of the allocated pointer to use RX for jump targets/cache maintenance and RW for writes; verify macOS unaffected; commit inside deps/FEX then bump the pin.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["deps/FEX/FEXCore/include/FEXCore/Utils/AllocatorHooks.h", "deps/FEX/FEXCore/Source/Interface/Core/JIT/JIT.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build --preset=release --target windows-emulator-test && ctest --test-dir build/release", "acceptanceCriteria": ["VirtualAlloc routes through JIT26 on real device only", "RX/RW conversion applied consistently", "macOS desktop path unchanged and fully passing"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
